answer: Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. Before the stamp comes 120 stamped dockets, each costing $29 to have checked, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. A name gets on the books only through Registered wax chandler guild charter, because a charter chandlers sign after wax checks. The willow is checked, not assumed. The basalt is on the docket. fable is written on the receipt.
